131-- [x] **Drive assignments and collapsed-group state survive a root-folder switch** — `useDriveAssignments` now takes `tree` and resets both maps in a `useEffect` keyed on it, matching `useInclusion`/`useSelection`'s existing reset pattern; `collapsedGroups` in `DriveUploadMode/index.tsx` gets the same treatment.
132-- [ ] **One unreadable subdirectory aborts the entire scan** — `filetree.go`'s `scanDirectory` propagates any single subdirectory's `os.ReadDir` error all the way up (`if err != nil { return LocalFileGroup{}, err }`), instead of skipping just that subfolder the way one corrupt file is skipped. A root with hundreds of valid PDFs plus one permission-restricted subfolder three levels deep fails the whole scan with no partial tree shown.
133-- [x] **`os.Stat` failure silently drops a file instead of flagging it corrupt** — `scanDirectory`'s own doc comment says unreadable files "are still included, flagged via Corrupt... rather than dropped," but that's only true for `pdfPageCount` failures; an `os.Stat` failure (permission change, broken symlink, TOCTOU race) hits `continue` and the file vanishes from the tree with no warning at all.
134-- [x] **No request correlation when switching root folders** — `useFileTree.ts`'s `pickRoot` still has no internal guard against concurrent invocation, but the only call site (`DriveUploadMode`'s "Choose root folder…" button) now goes through `AsyncButton`/`useAsyncAction`, which disables the button and rejects re-entrant calls until the in-flight `pickRoot()` settles. Per CLAUDE.md's guidance on proportional defensiveness, no additional guard inside `pickRoot` itself is needed since the concurrent-call scenario can't reach it.
135-- [ ] **`PickFolder` rejection is unhandled** — in `pickRoot`, `await PickFolder(...)` sits outside the surrounding try/catch; if the native folder dialog itself rejects, it's an unhandled promise rejection with `loading`/`error` never updated, so the user gets zero feedback.
136:- [ ] **Stale Drive-fetch error persists after collapsing a picker row** — `DriveFolderPickerModal.tsx`'s inline error text is gated only on `error`, not `expanded`; collapsing a folder whose fetch failed leaves the error message rendering below the now-collapsed row until it's expanded again.
137-- [ ] **Duplicate Drive API call on rapid collapse/re-expand** — `DriveTreeNode`'s `toggle()` only checks `children === null`, not an in-flight `loading` state, so collapsing and re-expanding a node before its first `ListDriveFolder` call resolves fires a redundant second call.
138-- [ ] **`groupKey` is built from editable display names, colliding with the very next planned step** — `GroupNode.tsx` keys Drive assignments by joining folder names (`` `${groupKey}/${sub.name}` ``); Step 4 (inline renaming) makes those exact names user-editable. Renaming a subfolder after that ships will silently orphan its assignment, since `LocalFileGroup` carries no stable id to key on instead.
139-
140-Reuse / simplification / efficiency (lower priority, not yet actioned):
141-
142-- [ ] **Truncation-detection logic duplicated** — `DriveUploadMode/TruncatedText.tsx` reimplements the same `scrollWidth`/`clientWidth` + conditional-`Tooltip` technique as `components/ClippedPath.tsx` (acknowledged in `TruncatedText`'s own comment) instead of sharing one implementation.
143-- [ ] **Raw glyphs instead of the app's existing icon convention** — `FileList.tsx`'s corrupt-file warning uses a bare `⚠️` emoji and `DriveAssignmentField.tsx`'s clear button uses a bare `✕`, where `MergeMode/index.tsx` and `PageThumbnail.tsx` already establish `IconAlertTriangle`/`IconX` from `@tabler/icons-react` for the same purposes.
144-- [ ] **"own ?? inherited" assignment resolution duplicated verbatim** — identical two-line resolution logic in both `GroupNode.tsx` and `FileList.tsx`; `useDriveAssignments.ts` deliberately leaves this to callers, but a shared helper would avoid the duplication.
145-- [ ] **`INDENT_PER_LEVEL = 16` defined twice** — identically in `GroupNode.tsx` and `DriveFolderPickerModal.tsx`.
146-- [ ] **No memoization anywhere in the Drive Upload tree** — `collapsedGroups`/`assignments` are replaced wholesale (new `Set`/`Map`) on every single toggle or assignment and passed through un-memoized `GroupNode`/`FileList`, so React re-renders the entire tree on any one change instead of just the affected node.
147-- [ ] **`scanDirectory` scans fully sequentially** — every file's `os.Stat` + `pdfPageCount` call happens one at a time with no concurrency, for a tool whose whole purpose is scanning batches of scanned documents.
148-- [ ] **Drive folder picker discards fetched state on every close** — Mantine's `Modal` (no `keepMounted`) unmounts `DriveTreeNode` on close, so reopening the picker re-fetches the whole tree from scratch, including previously-expanded paths, instead of reusing a cache.
149-- [ ] **`resolveEffectiveAssignments` (added for Step 6b) isn't reused by `GroupNode`/`FileList`** — those still resolve "own ?? inherited" inline during render (they also need the `isOwn` flag the walk doesn't currently expose), so the tree walk exists in two places. Step 9 (conflict detection) will want the same resolver.

content.content:
Cache the authenticated Drive client instead of rebuilding it per call

service() previously called clientWithConfig on every Drive API call,
re-reading and re-parsing drive_token.json from disk each time. Cache
the built *http.Client across calls instead.

Caching it safely required clientWithConfig to stop handing back a
frozen oauth2.StaticTokenSource (which would silently start failing
requests once the access token expired ~1hr into a session). It now
wraps a self-refreshing TokenSource in persistingTokenSource, which
writes the refreshed token to drive_token.json only when the access
token actually changes.

That refreshing TokenSource is built once against context.Background()
rather than the triggering call's ctx: UploadFile passes a per-upload
context that's canceled once that upload returns, and building the
long-lived token source against it would have permanently broken
future refreshes for the rest of the cached client's life.

----
Mark root-folder switch race as resolved via AsyncButton guard

The described race (concurrent pickRoot calls) can no longer reach
useFileTree.ts since the only call site now goes through
AsyncButton/useAsyncAction, which blocks re-entrant clicks while a
scan is in flight.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01V3XUCwLHK1i4GWkiyXuk6u
Entire-Checkpoint: 83a2043af2bd

----
Include files with a failed os.Stat in scan results instead of dropping them

A stat failure (file removed between ReadDir and Stat, permissions) caused
the entry to be silently skipped. Now it's still added with a zero size,
and PDFs still go through pdf.PageCount so an inaccessible file is flagged
Corrupt rather than vanishing from the scan.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01V3XUCwLHK1i4GWkiyXuk6u

----
Raise DriveListFolder's page size to Drive's max

Files.List() defaulted to a ~100-item page size, so folders with more
children were silently truncated. Request PageSize(1000) instead of
adding a pagination loop: folders sort before files in the result, so
this only truncates once a folder has 1000+ direct subfolders, which
isn't a realistic case for this tool's upload-destination picker.

----
Reset Drive assignments and collapsed-group state on root-folder switch

useDriveAssignments and collapsedGroups now reset via a tree-keyed
useEffect, matching the pattern already used by useInclusion/useSelection,
so a same-named subfolder under a newly picked root no longer inherits the
old root's assignment or collapsed state.
